title: Allergy Action Plan Permission Slip Form
subtitle: An original operational permission slip for allergy action plan that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Allergy Action Plan Permission Slip Form supports the complete allergy action plan workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Allergy Action Plan Permission Slip Form when the assigned allergy-plan coordinator needs one fillable record for approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Allergy action plan permission slip identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this permission slip to one approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan record reference

fields.label: School, program, meal, or activity site

blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Allergy action plan requested participation and permission scope
sections.guidance: Separate each requested activity and condition so one choice does not imply another.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan permission choices
items: Use of the current approved allergy action plan in the named setting
Meal, snack, classroom, and activity controls as documented
Minimum-necessary communication with assigned staff
Emergency medication only from the approved authorization
Emergency services and guardian contact through documented routes
Transport or off-site plan only when separately reviewed
Return, replacement, or transfer of supplies through approved custody
Held or stopped participation recorded when controls cannot be confirmed
blocks.guidance: Each item is independent; document any exclusion or condition in the scope table.

blocks.label: Permission and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records an allergy action-plan workflow; it does not diagnose an allergy, interpret symptoms, invent exposure limits, or replace qualified directions or emergency services. Use only the current approved plan and authorization. Stop routine activity for any mismatch, suspected exposure, symptom, or unavailable control, protect privacy, and route response decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan guardian routing, readiness, and support review
sections.guidance: Confirm contact, release, support, and stop conditions before relying on the permission record.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring review before participation
items: Student identity, allergen, plan, or emergency supply does not match
Plan is missing, illegible, expired, changed, or unavailable
Food label, ingredient, meal, snack, or cross-contact control is unclear
Emergency medication, trained staff, or required setting is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or administration event occurred
Classroom, transport, field trip, or activity environment changed
Immediate breathing, circulation, consciousness, or other emergency concern is active
Response, supply count, notification, or follow-up does not reconcile

blocks.label: Participation support, limitation, owner, and evidence
Guardian questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

fields.label: Questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

sections.title: Allergy action plan permission decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Preserve approved, declined, conditional, and unresolved scope as separate decisions.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan permission decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the guardian, qualified health professional, and authorized allergy-response staff.

blocks.label: Decision rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

fields.label: Rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

sections.title: Allergy action plan permission exceptions and operating handoff
sections.guidance: Do not force agreement; assign unresolved scope and communicate operating limits.

blocks.label: Permission exception and stop indicators
items: Routine activity cannot proceed under the current allergy plan
Guardian authorization or qualified plan direction is incomplete
Student, allergen, plan, medication, or supply does not reconcile
Meal, activity, cross-contact, staffing, or setting control is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or emergency response is active
Response, supply custody, notification, or follow-up remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, immediate control, owner, escalation, and disposition
Approved-scope handoff requirements
items: Approved and declined scope communicated to assigned staff
Conditions and stop points visible at the point of use
Guardian and qualified-review sources linked
Release, transport, or setting limits routed when applicable
Unresolved permission has an owner and due point
Completion evidence and record location identified

sections.title: Allergy action plan outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan closeout controls
items: Allergy-plan readiness and response status accepted
Guardian and qualified-review communication recorded
Unresolved exposure, control, or supply action has an owner
Emergency medication and equipment returned to approved custody
Meal, facility, health, or program follow-up linked
Allergy record stored with privacy and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Permission Slip closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
